subject: POC trial planning + final readout scheduling - Aurora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Sanjay / Lina —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

1) What we heard
- Primary use case: accelerate triage and clinical documentation summarization across 3 pilot clinics (ED + urgent care).
- Main constraints: PHI handling, on-prem/private deployment requirement for patient data, and tight latency SLO for clinician workflows (~200ms median).
- Success metric: reduction in average documentation time per encounter by 20% and >=95% accuracy on key structured fields vs. clinician gold set.

2) Proposed POC approach
- 4-week trial using Redwood Private in Aurora test VPC (non-prod).
- Week 0: infra prep & data sanity checks
- Weeks 1-3: ingest sample data, run evaluation prompts + weekly checkpoints
- Week 4: final readout + exec decision

3) Owners / next steps
- Redwood: I'll lead POC coordination (marissa.cole@redwood.com). Marcus will own infra/ops and quant/profile recommendations.
- Aurora: Sanjay will be day-to-day PM; Lina to coordinate clinician access and evaluation set.

4) Immediate asks
- Aurora: share a de-identified sample set (SFTP link or Drive) + point of contact for VPN/VPC networking.
- Redwood: we'll send a detailed success-criteria doc + mutual action plan by EOD tomorrow.

I've attached a short success criteria draft and the mutual action plan for review. If the plan looks good we'll kick off infra prep this week and target a final readout the week of March 28.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aurora_POC_success_criteria.docx, redwood_mutual_action_plan.pdf

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>

Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks Marissa — this looks right to me. Couple quick clarifications: 

- We can provide a de-identified sample CSV and a 5k-clinician-goldset for evaluation. Lina will share by Wed EOD.
- On PHI: our security/compliance team needs a short questionnaire answered before we allow any infra access — can you loop in Neha or the security contact?
- Exec timing: our CMO wants to see a readout the week of March 28 (preferably Mar 29 morning PST). She'll make the go/no-go.

Also — can you confirm whether Private deployment can run in our Azure tenancy or do we need a Redwood-managed VPC? Latency for clinician workflows is critical.

Sanjay

Sanjay.Rao@aurorahealth.com | (617) 555-9083

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery call - POC plan + success criteria

Thanks Sanjay — copying Neha for security/compliance Qs and Marcus for infra details. 

Attached is an updated POC plan with concrete success criteria and an evaluation plan. TL;DR: 
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  * Documentation time reduction >=20% measured across sample encounters
  * Structured-field extraction precision >=95% on the clinician gold set
  * Latency: median token response <250ms in Aurora test VPC under expected load profile
  * No critical security gaps from our checklist (SOC2 controls + network isolation)

- Evaluation plan:
  * Week 0 (Mar 24-26): infra prep, test data ingest, access for 2 clinicians
  * Weeks 1-3 (Mar 27-Apr 16): run daily eval jobs, weekly syncs (Mon), refine prompts
  * Week 4 (Apr 19-23): final readout materials and exec summary (we can compress to Mar 29 if infra ready)

- Ownership:
  * Redwood: infra and model ops (Marcus), prompt engineering & eval harness (me)
  * Aurora: data & clinician availability (Lina), decision authority (CMO)

I've attached: Aurora_POC_success_criteria.docx and Aurora_POC_milestones.xlsx. Also linking our mutual action plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bPOCPlan

Marcus - quick asks for you:
- Can Redwood run Private in Aurora's Azure tenancy? If not, confirm estimated additional latency for Redwood-managed VPC (ballpark).
- Can you prepare an infra checklist (VPN + service account + storage permissions) by EOD Thu?

Neha - can you confirm who on security will handle Aurora's questionnaire? We'll need the questionnaire responses before infra access.

Thanks — aiming to turn this POC around quickly.

- Marissa

Attachments: Aurora_POC_success_criteria.docx, Aurora_POC_milestones.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan + infra checklist

Marissa - quick infra notes: 

- Azure tenancy: We can deploy Redwood Private into Aurora's subscription - requires a couple of service principals and a minimal VM/GPU footprint in region eastus2. This will meet latency SLOs; expected median token latency ~180-220ms under the pilot load.
- If Aurora prefers Redwood-managed VPC, add ~30-60ms on median (depends on region).
- I attached a short infra checklist and the initial estimated resource commit (small GPU pool).

Action items I'll take:
- Deliver infra checklist + ARM templates by EOD Thu (25th) - attached as Aurora_POC_milestones.xlsx
- Stand up a staging cluster once we have service principal and storage access (I'll ping once provisioned)

Marissa - for contract planning: if the CMO signs off after the readout we'll need to hand off to commercial to lock a 12-month Dedicated commitment. Recommend we get a light SOW ready in parallel. Marcus will coordinate resource sizing for the quote.

Marcus
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
